records.name: Melanie Dixon
records.notes: Peralta CCD trustees approved Dixon's appointment; she began July 15, 2024. Previously Associate VC of Educational Services & Student Success at Los Rios CCD and President of American River College.

records.name: Pamela Luster
records.notes: Served as Acting President of College of Alameda bridging the gap until Dixon's arrival in July 2024. Name/tenure of the last permanent president before Luster could not be confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Anthony J. Iacono
records.notes: Became CCM's third president on September 1, 2016. Named ACCT 2026 Chief Executive Officer for the Northeast Region and a 2026 ROI-NJ Influencer. Prior institution/title not specified on CCM's own bio page.

records.name: Edward J. Yaw
records.notes: Second president of CCM; retired in 2016 after 30 years of service. A campus building was named in his honor.

records.name: Sherman H. Masten
records.notes: First president of County College of Morris; retired in 1986 after two decades of leadership (college founded in the 1960s).

seats.university: City Colleges of Chicago-Harold Washington College

records.name: Daniel López
records.notes: Named president of Harold Washington College (City Colleges of Chicago) on December 5, 2019. Later named Vice Chair of HACU's Governing Board (2024) and appointed to related boards in 2026. Dr. Peggy Korellis reportedly served as brief interim leader between Ignacio Lopez's departure and López's appointment.

records.name: Ignacio Lopez
records.notes: Terminated as Harold Washington College president effective July 31, 2019, for violating a City Colleges residency requirement.

seats.university: Wichita State University-Campus of Applied Sciences and Technology

records.name: Sheree Utash
records.notes: Has served as President of WSU Tech (formerly Wichita Area Technical College) since 2015; also holds title of VP of Workforce Development for Wichita State University. She led WATC's 2018 affiliation with Wichita State University that created the current campus name. Prior WATC president before her tenure could not be confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Pedro Avila
records.notes: Selected by the Gavilan Joint Community College District Governing Board on May 19, 2022; took office July 18, 2022, as the college's 8th president. Name of the 7th president (predecessor) could not be confirmed from available sources.

records.name: Pamela Lau
records.notes: Became Parkland's sixth president in January 2023 after a three-year succession plan; named president-designate in 2019. Trustees later approved a raise and two-year contract extension through June 2027.

records.name: Thomas M. (Tom) Ramage
records.notes: Fifth president of Parkland College; retired at the end of 2022.

records.name: Adam Breerwood
records.notes: Named the 11th President of Pearl River Community College in 2017 after rising internally through roles including Director of Recruitment, Dean of Students, and Vice President. 2017 AACC Administrator of the Year.

records.name: William A. Lewis
records.notes: 10th President of Pearl River Community College, serving from 2000 until Breerwood's appointment in 2017, per the college's official presidential timeline.

records.name: Ted J. Alexander
records.notes: 9th President of Pearl River Community College, per the college's official presidential timeline.

records.name: Robert K. Nye
records.notes: Joined FLCC on July 1, 2016, as the institution's fifth president.

records.name: Barbara G. Risser
records.notes: Fourth president of FLCC, serving August 2007 to August 2016.

records.name: Daniel T. Hayes
records.notes: Third president of FLCC, serving July 1992 to June 2007.

records.name: Michael Torrence
records.notes: Seventh seated president of Motlow State Community College, named in 2018. Hilda Tunstill served as interim president in 2017 between Kinkel's departure and Torrence's arrival.

records.name: Anthony Kinkel
records.notes: Sixth president of Motlow State, 2015-2017.

records.name: MaryLou Apple
records.notes: Fifth president of Motlow State, 2006-2015.

records.name: Howard J. Spearman
records.notes: Current President and CEO of Rock Valley College; his employment contract covers 2023-2027, indicating a 2023 start. Exact start date and prior title not published on the fetched page. At least one intervening president between Roland Chapdelaine (took office 1997) and Spearman was not identifiable from available sources.

records.name: Roland Chapdelaine
records.notes: Became RVC's third president in 1997 upon Karl Jacobs' retirement. End date of his tenure not specified in available sources; there is a confirmed gap in the record between Chapdelaine and Spearman.

records.name: Unknown
records.notes: GAP: Could not confirm the current chancellor of Northshore Technical Community College (part of the Louisiana Community and Technical College System, serving Livingston, St. Helena, St. Tammany, Tangipahoa, and Washington parishes) during this research session. The college's own website (northshorecollege.edu) consistently returned server errors (403/503) to automated access, and web search quota was exhausted before this school could be researched via search. Needs follow-up research directly against the college site or LCTCS.

records.name: Jason Morrison
records.notes: Dr. Jason Morrison, EdD, is the current president of Trinity Valley Community College per the college's own website. His start date and predecessor could not be confirmed this session: the college's dedicated leadership page and Wikipedia infobox both list only his name without tenure history, and web search quota was exhausted before this could be pursued further.

records.name: Randall J. VanWagoner
records.notes: Randall J. VanWagoner is confirmed as MVCC's current president via the college's own site and Wikipedia infobox. His 2010 start year is based on publicly known biographical background rather than a source directly confirmed during this session (the college's news and leadership subpages returned 404s to automated access, and web search quota was exhausted). His predecessor could not be confirmed this session and should be verified directly.

records.name: James Henningsen
records.notes: Assumed the presidency of College of Central Florida in 2012, confirmed on the college's own president page and Wikipedia.

records.name: Jim Hinson
records.notes: Retired Tallahassee Community College president who served as interim president of CF to help stabilize college finances, prior to Henningsen's 2012 appointment.

records.name: Charles "Chick" Dassance
records.notes: President at the time the college was renamed from Central Florida Community College to College of Central Florida on May 25, 2010; end year approximate.

records.name: Misaki Takabayashi
records.notes: Recommended as next Kapi'olani Community College chancellor in a November 2022 University of Hawai'i announcement, with an effective start date of March 1, 2023.

records.name: Louise Pagotto
records.notes: Publicly known to have served as a prior Kapi'olani CC chancellor before Takabayashi, but exact tenure dates could not be independently re-confirmed this session (dedicated bio pages were not accessible); flagged for verification.

records.name: Kimberly Blosser
records.notes: President since April 2019, initially of Lord Fairfax Community College, which was renamed Laurel Ridge Community College in July 2021.

records.name: Cheryl Thompson-Stacy
records.notes: President of Lord Fairfax Community College (predecessor institution), January 2009 to April 2019.

records.name: John Sygielski
records.notes: President of Lord Fairfax Community College, 2003 to May 2008.

records.name: Saul Reyes
records.notes: Named the fifth president of Walters State in August 2025, beginning his tenure in September 2025. Thomas Sewell served as interim president between Miksa's June 2025 departure and Reyes's arrival.

records.name: Anthony (Tony) Miksa
records.notes: Fourth president of Walters State, June 2016 to June 2025; oversaw capital projects on the Sevier County and Niswonger campuses.

records.name: Wade B. McCamey
records.notes: Third president of Walters State, 2005-2016; previously led Roane State Community College.

records.name: Galen DeHay
records.notes: Confirmed as current president of Tri-County Technical College via Wikipedia's infobox. The college's own site (tctc.edu) was inaccessible to automated fetches (persistent 503 errors) during this session, so his start date and predecessor (publicly reported to be long-serving former president Ronnie L. Booth) could not be independently re-confirmed here; flagged for direct follow-up verification.
